audit_events_previous_digest_uidx.name: audit_events_previous_digest_uidx
audit_events_previous_digest_uidx.where: "audit_events"."previous_digest" is not null and "audit_events"."digest" is not null

claim_sessions_active_user_code_uidx.name: claim_sessions_active_user_code_uidx
claim_sessions_active_user_code_uidx.where: "claim_sessions"."user_code_digest" is not null and "claim_sessions"."state" in ('pending','presented','authenticated','reviewed') and "claim_sessions"."revoked_at" is null

interactions_decided_at_check.name: interactions_decided_at_check
interactions_decided_at_check.value: "interactions"."status" not in ('denied','consumed') or "interactions"."decided_at" is not null
